items.question: What technical support and technician enablement does Solvex provide to new franchise partners?
items.answer: We provide turnkey engineering enablement: structured hands-on masterclasses covering civil roof load calculations, 3D shadow analysis, high-voltage DC string design, pre-cleared DISCOM documentation packets, and direct access to our central engineering escalation desk.

items.question: What is the typical operational onboarding timeline for an authorized territory franchise?
items.answer: From formal agreement execution and territorial rights allocation to commercial dispatch typically spans 14 to 21 business days. This window covers initial depot warehousing allocations, ERP terminal onboarding, localized digital lead generation setup, and technician safety certifications.

items.question: What commercial gross margins and working capital cycles can distribution partners model?
items.answer: Authorized territorial distributors typically structure margins ranging from 18% to 26% across hybrid inverters, industrial PCUs, and turnkey generation kits. Under the PM Surya Ghar scheme, streamlined direct benefit transfers (DBT) ensure 30-day working capital velocity on residential rooftop arrays.

items.question: Are all Solvex PCU, Inverter, and Photovoltaic packages compliant with ALMM & MNRE mandates?
items.answer: Unconditionally. Every photovoltaic module supplied is ALMM List-I compliant with domestic solar cell content (DCR). Our inverters, PCUs, and balance-of-systems components carry mandatory BIS certifications and are pre-registered on state utility DISCOM portals for direct net-meter sanctioning.

items.question: How does the Solvex 360 warranty replacement protocol operate in case of hardware anomalies?
items.answer: We operate decentralized regional buffer inventory hubs guaranteeing 48-hour RMA swap-outs. In addition, our smart hybrid inverters and PCUs transmit real-time cloud telemetry, enabling automated predictive diagnostics and remote firmware patches prior to physical field dispatches.
